actions.label: Track LOCK
actions.description: Lock the target: the detector's relock candidate if one is shown, otherwise the centre of the image (point the camera at it first)

actions.label: GO (default)
actions.description: ONE press: GO now (with --go-confirm: 1st press arms and shows distance/ETA, 2nd within 3 s confirms). Uses the tracker's configured speed (30 m/s) directly on the target (offset = 0)

actions.label: GO 15 m/s, stop 3 m short
actions.description: GO at 15 m/s, stopping 3 m before the target. One press.

actions.label: GO, stop 10 m past
actions.description: GO at configured speed (30 m/s), passing directly over the target, stopping 10 m PAST it (param2 = -10). One press.

actions.label: GO high-speed 30 m/s, on target
actions.description: High-speed FPV Dash at 30 m/s directly on the target (param1 = 30 m/s, param2 = 0 m). One press.

actions.label: ABORT (climb away)
actions.description: Leave the target and climb (--abort-climb, default 10 m), then hold in GUIDED

actions.label: Track UNLOCK
actions.description: Drop the target lock and stop following

actions.label: BRAKE
actions.description: Panic button: stop the companion's go-to and switch the vehicle to BRAKE
